title: Hearty Shallot Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado
description: A festive Peruvian dish featuring tender sous-vide beef, shallots, and a variety of vegetables, all in one flavorful pan.

ingredients.name: shallots
ingredients.notes: about 1 inch in diameter, thinly sliced

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.notes: use gluten-free soy sauce for gluten-free diet

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use 1 tsp for each tbsp if using a flavored oil

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use gluten-free salt for gluten-free diet

instructions: Preheat a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the sous-vide beef in the paella pan for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the beef from the paella pan and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the olive oil to the paella pan.
Add the thinly sliced shallots and cook for 5 minutes or until they start to caramelize.
Add the sliced onion and cook for another 5 minutes or until it starts to soften.
Add the diced tomatoes, bell pepper, and aji amarillo peppers to the paella pan.
Cook for another 5 minutes or until the vegetables start to soften.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce and cook for 1 minute, until the sauce starts to thicken.
Return the beef to the paella pan and cook for another 5 minutes or until the beef is cooked to your liking.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Hearty Shallot Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
